name: My Anemic Disposition
source:
It's Friday after class and you're taking the bus home.

A classmate is hosting a party out of town. 

Would you go?

Why waste the effort even?

[From [url=https://tomthebastard.itch.io/my-anemic-disposition]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天是星期五，放学后，你要坐公共汽车回家。

一位同学要在城外举办聚会。

你会去吗？

为什么还要浪费精力呢？

[来自[url=https://tomthebastard.itch.io/my-anemic-disposition]Itch.io[/url]]
